title: Exploring Explainable Multi-agent MCTS-minimax Hybrids in Board Game Using Process Mining
abstract: arXiv:2503.23326v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Monte-Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is a family of sampling-based search algorithms widely used for online planning in sequential decision-making domains and at the heart of many recent advances in artificial intelligence. Understanding the behavior of MCTS agents is difficult for developers and users due to the frequently large and complex search trees that result from the simulation of many possible futures, their evaluations, and their relationships. This paper presents our ongoing investigation into potential explanations for the decision-making and behavior of MCTS. A weakness of MCTS is that it constructs a highly selective tree and, as a result, can miss crucial moves and fall into tactical traps. Full-width minimax search constitutes the solution. We integrate shallow minimax search into the rollout phase of multi-agent MCTS and use process mining technique to explain agents' strategies in 3v3 checkers.

translated_title: 基于过程挖掘的棋类游戏中可解释多智能体MCTS-极小极大混合算法探索
translated_abstract: 蒙特卡洛树搜索是一类基于采样的搜索算法，广泛应用于序贯决策领域的在线规划，并且是近年来许多人工智能进展的核心。由于模拟大量可能的未来情景、其评估及其相互关系会产生庞大而复杂的搜索树，开发者和用户很难理解MCTS智能体的行为。本文介绍了我们针对MCTS决策与行为的潜在解释所开展的持续研究。MCTS的一个弱点是它会构建一棵高度选择性的树，因此可能错过关键走法并陷入战术陷阱。全宽度极小极大搜索则可以解决这一问题。我们将浅层极小极大搜索集成到多智能体MCTS的模拟阶段，并使用过程挖掘技术来解释智能体在3v3跳棋中的策略。
tldr: 本文将浅层极小极大搜索融入多智能体MCTS的模拟阶段，克服了MCTS因树过度剪枝而错过关键走法、陷入战术陷阱的弱点，并利用过程挖掘技术对智能体在3v3跳棋中的策略进行可解释性分析。
en_tdlr: This paper integrates shallow minimax search into the rollout phase of multi-agent MCTS to overcome its weakness of missing crucial moves and falling into tactical traps, and employs process mining to provide explainability for agents' strategies in 3v3 checkers.
